clips.label: The Cartographer’s Dream · new ending · 1:15
clips.note: The inked landscape curls into a world of its own, then opens into an intricate paper form encircled by a blue ribbon. The new ending begins at 1:00.
clips.details:
The approved first minute continues into a new fifteen-second ending. A curling paper landscape becomes a globe; its blue river leaves the surface and forms an orbit. The final world becomes a deeply pleated paper sculpture, with a short gentler closing movement. Two later branches that drifted toward literal Earth/map imagery are preserved outside this cut.

Silent 75-second cut, 1536×1024, 24 fps. All 675 selected paintings are retained, including the unchanged original 540. The delivery clock remains 4.5× source speed, equivalent to 3× the original Storm Engine delivery clock. RIFE fills two- and three-frame painting intervals outside recurrence. Two additional final frames hold the last painting (0.083 seconds).

The imagery is a continuous painted transformation; small geography and folds redraw. The globe briefly resembles Earth during its reveal, and the crater repaints rapidly around 66.2 seconds. Human feedback on this new ending is pending.

clips.label: The Cartographer’s Dream · original 1 minute
clips.note: Follow a blue ink river from an ivory atlas through waterfalls, amethyst caverns and enormous paper folds into a branching delta.
clips.details:
A new story directed around faster floating camera movement. Close banks and mineral formations pass the camera, the river opens a route through a giant paper arch, and a travelling pullback reveals the blue ink network. The blue route, pale sculptural landforms and warm light connect the changing worlds. Small incidental figures appear briefly around the waterfall; individual details continue to redraw.

Silent 60-second cut, 1536×1024, 24 fps. All 540 selected paintings are retained. Delivery runs at 4.5× the source clock, equivalent to 3× the original Storm Engine delivery clock, with varied camera paths and acceleration. RIFE fills the two- and three-frame painting intervals outside recurrence. Two additional frames hold the last painting (0.083 seconds).
